name: 19044 · Horsham, PA
findings: ZIP 19044 (Horsham) has 54 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19044 (Horsham) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19044 (Horsham) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
